notes.title: [UPDATE] Version 1.4 is here !
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40100324/57c261d5ecf52faff6974c67aafa5de70c590ff5.png[/img]

[h1]Version [b]1.4[/b] is here ![/h1]

and here's what she brings with her!

[u][h2]New arrivals :[/h2][/u]

• Multiplayer !
[i]Face up to 8 Players and respond as fast and as best as possible in order to win the game![/i]

• Player Profile !
[i]Look other player's statistics or, your's[/i]


[u][h2]Patchs :[/h2][/u]

• Cannot click the same button twice in a row at an interval of less than 2 seconds

• Saving sound settings between each game start


[u][h2]Changes :[/h2][/u]

• Deletion of VorTeXDev accounts ! [i](We now use Steam Accounts)[/i]

• Deletion of confirmation when deleting a quiz


Note : [i]Quizzes and VorTeX accounts have been deleted.[/i]



Thanks for reading !

Take the time to put a [i][u]Positive vote[/u][/i] ːsteamthumbsupː !
